item.title: 2026-11-28 No.007 Apple and Samsung take 82% of US phones, mini-LED TVs more than double
item.description: Counterpoint says US smartphone shipments fell 9% in Q3, but Apple (57%) and Samsung (25%) now hold 82% combined. TrendForce expects global mini-LED TV shipments to rise 116% this year to 28.78M units. Omdia forecasts 65-inch LCD TV panel costs to rise 6.5% YoY in Q4.
